feeds.title: Mazars Financial Modelling Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with all the news from Mazars in our collection of regular blogs by the team at Mazars Financial Modelling. Mazars Financial Modelling designs and delivers world-leading financial modelling, valuations and project finance courses for professionals and teams in infrastructure, energy, natural resources and real estate.

feeds.title: The Financial Modelling Podcast Blog
feeds.description: The Financial Modelling Podcast blog brings you the latest Financial Modelling podcasts and blogs. The podcast looks at how financial models impact companies and deals, how they are used to understand complex transactions and their role in the global economy.

feeds.title: A Simple Model
feeds.description: Read insightful articles written by Peter Lynch and get more information on Financial Modelling with A Simple Model. The objective at ASimpleModel.com is to make financial modeling instruction and private equity training accessible and affordable.

feeds.title: Gridlines Blog
feeds.description: The latest blogs and thought leadership from our financial modelling blog. Gridlines is a rapidly growing financial modelling and advisory practice. We work in close collaboration with our clients, helping them to make robust business and investment decisions.

feeds.title: Synario Blog
feeds.description: Find resources to support every financial modeling challenge. From getting started to in-depth market overviews and more. Synario's mission is to make financial modeling, analysis, and collaboration easier. Synario offers powerful financial modeling features that increase the efficiency and performance of any finance department.

feeds.title: Financial Modeling World Cup Blog
feeds.description: Financial Modeling World Cup provides blogs that can educate you on the topic of Financial Modelling. We promote financial modeling as a tool for education, training and competition. Industry-leading professionals are determined by competing against one another here at Financial Modeling World Cup.

feeds.title: Financial Modelling Handbook
feeds.description: The complete guide to building financial models for corporate finance, project finance, real estate and FP&A. The Handbook is a series of useful guides on financial modelling, published for free online, and then in print. One that provides an ongoing reference that you can come back to whenever you get stuck.

feeds.title: Model Citizn Blog
feeds.description: Read blogs about financial and business modelling with Model Citizn's informative blogs. Model Citizn is a financial services company with decades of combined experience and has been involved in many corporate, government and semi-government financial modelling projects.

feeds.title: eFinancialModels Blog
feeds.description: Blog related to topics in financial modeling in Excel, financial analysis, raising financing and other related topics. eFinancialModels has been created to help entrepreneurs, key executives and investors in their financial analysis and modeling tasks.
